top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a quantitative, falsifiable prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at a magic angle) followed by experimental realisation of tunable correlated insulators and superconductivity, reproduced across many groups over about eight years and extended to other moire platforms. Its citation is confined to the prediction and observed phenomena, so the unresolved pairing mechanism need not be claimed, as with 1987 high-temperature superconductivity. The omission of Yuan Cao and twist-angle disorder are real costs that I weigh seriously, but I judge the breadth of the new platform to outweigh them, narrowly. P001 (optical lattice clocks) is a mature, cleanly attributed and fully defensible prize that I would accept, so it ranks second; any award is preferred to no award.
recusal_note: No specific conflict from profile; field proximity only, since I work on electronic-structure and many-body theory and two-dimensional materials, which could bias me toward moire quantum matter. No documented tie to MacDonald, Bistritzer, Jarillo-Herrero, Katori or Ye.
